ValidationRule.description: Before Statement of Completed Travel Status Field can be selected to "SOCT Completed – entire SOCT completed, reimbursement check received, travel report uploaded" the Final Report Uploaded Checkbox needs to be set to true
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(StatementOfCompletedTravelStatus__c), ISPICKVAL(StatementOfCompletedTravelStatus__c, 'SOCT Completed – entire SOCT completed, reimbursement check received, travel report uploaded'), NOT(Final_Report_Uploaded__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL( TravelType__c , 'Intra-State')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before Statement of Completed Travel Status Field can be selected to "SOCT Completed – entire SOCT completed, reimbursement check received, travel report uploaded" the Final Report Uploaded Checkbox needs to be set to true
